definitions.explanation: The physical force used to pull or tow something, such as a vehicle or load.
The ability of a person, organization, or idea to draw others along and lead progress, used metaphorically.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{牽引力|けんいんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This engine has strong pulling power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{牽引力|けんいんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。

⟦{路面|ろめん}→路面：16490_romen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍結|とうけつ}→凍結：09613_touketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{牽引力|けんいんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{牽引|けんいん}→牽引：13498_kenin⟧ (towing/pulling) + {力|りょく} (force/power). The physical meaning (sense 1) is used in automotive and engineering contexts, while the figurative meaning (sense 2) is common in business and political discourse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牽引力|けんいんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have strong pulling power
- {牽引力|けんいんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to exert traction/driving force
- {牽引力|けんいんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧: to serve as a driving force
- {牽引力|けんいんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: traction/momentum drops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推進力|すいしんりょく}→推進力：15905_suishinryoku⟧: propulsive force; driving power — pushes from behind, while {牽引力|けんいんりょく} pulls from the front
- ⟦{原動力|げんどうりょく}→原動力：20578_gendouryoku⟧: motive force; prime mover — emphasizes the origin of energy rather than the direction
- {求心力|きゅうしんりょく}: centripetal force; power to attract — emphasizes drawing people/things to a center
